fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting on local economic and labor conditions after the Supreme Court decision ending NRA enforcement, including calls for voluntary maintenance of wages and hours. Prominent coverage attacks illegal gambling in Miami, focusing on the spread of marble-board gambling and alleged syndicate operations, and urges city investigation and enforcement. Political items include state and local office “whispers” and a report that Miami Beach mayor Louis A. Snedigar may resign. The issue also advocates a referendum campaign to end dog racing in Dade County, and contains sports/racing columns and extensive local advertising.
